ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review as a safety/dangerous-driving report: preserve the trip telematics and chat log, obtain the rider's and driver's accounts, and inform the rider of the 995 / driver commercial insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths. No fare adjustment is to be made in the meantime.

rejected_claims.reason: Rejected as a request for no_action: although F2 (12.8 min vs 14 min estimate) shows the trip was no slower than estimated, duration alone does not measure speed, braking or lane position, and SAFE-2 requires a dangerous-driving allegation to go to human review rather than be dismissed on the papers [F2][SAFE-2].

Rejected: F1 records only path length (8.5 km vs 8.6 km optimal, no off-route segment) and says nothing about lane position or shoulder use, so a 0.1 km shorter path cannot contradict the shoulder-overtaking allegation [F1][SAFE-2].

Rejected: SAFE-2 is triggered by the dangerous-driving allegation itself and sets no precondition of a documented incident, injury or prior record, so the absence of traffic/incident facts (and the clean profiles F6/F7) does not lower the case below the escalation threshold [F6][F7][SAFE-2].

Accepted only in its negative part and therefore not a basis for no_action: it is correct that the fixed $21.04 RydeX quote is unaffected by mileage and that no refund or fee waiver arises under FARE-1, which is why the amount is null, but this does not dispose of the safety allegation, which SAFE-2 routes to escalation [F1][F2][FARE-1][SAFE-2].
